doc: Firefly, REMADE 2026-11-06 (流萤.pmx, H:\BACKUP_20260815\Modding\PBR\星穹铁道_流萤\星穹铁道流萤; asset 32c908bc, the same PMX and textures as asset 0d01d7d3 of firefly_r18_0d01d7d3, whose layer it replaces: that layer sorted first and would have won every shared hash), ragdoll in the active session, applied without AABB at the user's request. 76 materials, 19 sheets. Carried over from the reviewed original (pins checked against the UV islands on 衣服.png and 兔女郎.png on 2026-10-25): 15 刻度表 skin (the belly-scale decal), 22 and 23 (the bunny suit's bodysuit and the pink binder) latex rubber 0.16, 26 and 27 (the bunny ears, outer and inner) cloth, 67 胸饰 (the silver figure-eight brooch, classed skin by 胸) and 70 袖子饰 (the sleeve ornament) metal; the bunny suit's white-silver trim (24) keeps satin 0.37, its bodysuit cloth 0.84; the fishnet stockings keep their full 11059x8847 sheet and the glossy nylon 0.23 the user accepted. What is new in the remake: the hashes of the hidden parts are now live (the bunny suit 兔女郎.png, the heels, the ears and the beads were predicted, and every prediction was wrong, so the old layer's bunny suit and ears never applied); the newer tuned fabric values (cloth 0.65 / rough_ai 0.35 / normal 2.0, leather 0.25 / 0.4, hair 0.38) replace the aggressive rough_ai that made dark paint glossy on Evernight; the bunny suit sheet (8192x4096, kept at full size by Model Hotloader) keeps its source size. What each part is for: OUTFIT (衣服.png 4096x2048, a cream-to-teal silk dress with silver and gold fittings): fabrics (裙子 skirts, 胸罩, 外套 coat, 袖子 sleeves, 背带, 肩带, 领带, 手套 gloves, 发饰 hair ornament) cloth; the fittings are their own metal materials (55 and 57 skirt, 59 the back bell, 66 衣饰铁, plus the pinned 67 brooch and 70 sleeve ornament) satin 0.30 (painted pale brass); 73 鞋子 and 74 鞋子饰内侧 leather; 29 and 30 (the beads and hook, 灰.jpg with a glass sphere map) gem; 22-25 bunny suit and 26-27 ears as above. The ropes, gag, blindfold, tongue, pasties, heels, blush, expression and the tattoos are byte-identical to sheets that Evernight's and other layers supply (the heels now share Evernight's live hash), so this layer carries only Firefly's own sheets: outfit, stockings, face, ears, beads, hair and bunny suit. SKIN: Body.png (8192), the neck, the belly-scale decal and the tattoos stay as Remix renders them, per the standard. ROUND 2 (2026-11-06, after a look in game): the thigh-high stockings at the earlier 0.23 read as high-gloss latex with long highlights, so they went to 0.35 (satin nylon; the other models' sheer stockings are 0.42).
